title: The Ball Over the Wall
text: {{name}} likes to play soccer every day. Today {{name}} kicks the ball very hard. The ball flies up high. It goes past a tall wall. Oh no! The ball is gone. {{name}} feels sad now. A garden is behind the wall. {{name}} is afraid to go there. But {{name}} wants the ball back. So {{name}} is brave today. {{name}} walks to the green gate. An old man opens the door. The man has a kind smile. 'Hello,' says {{name}}. 'My ball is in your garden.' The man laughs. 'Come in!' says the man. The ball is by a rose bush. {{name}} picks it up. 'Thank you,' says {{name}}. 'Can you play with me?' The old man smiles. They kick the ball together. Now they are good friends. What a happy afternoon!

questions.prompt: How does {{name}} feel before going to the gate?
What do {{name}} and the old man do at the end?

summary: 主角踢球太用力,球飞过高墙落入邻居花园;主角鼓起勇气去敲门,善良的老人把球还给主角并一起踢球,两人成了好朋友。
